pages.text: Hierarch Artanis waits under the dome of the mothership high in the stratosphere over the protoss base.

A blinding dash and psionic storm. At 2/3 health he calls zealots, a stalker and a high templar and his shields come back; at 1/3 he rages and calls more.$(br2)$(l)When beaten$() Amun's hold breaks and the hero joins you (see Amun's Hold), leaving: Artanis's Helmet, the rest of a protoss suit, 16 shards, 8 diamonds.
